plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: Drive an Obsidian vault from the terminal — daily notes, search, file ops, tags, tasks, plugin reloading, and headless scripting via the official obsidian CLI.

plugins.name: readout
plugins.description: Report operational results as terse machine readouts — delta bridges, scan tables, verdict blocks, alarm stacks, and event sequences — instead of narrative prose.

plugins.name: domain-gloss
plugins.description: Keep the English domain term and attach a short inline gloss in your first language — so jargon teaches instead of blocking. Covers specialist terms and false friends, the easy-looking words that mean something else in the domain. Any domain, including software; narrow it with a skip list.

plugins.name: thai-natural-voice
plugins.description: Draft and rewrite audience-native Thai for agents, technical work, and publishing with configurable generic and source-inspired presets.
